ddc.rawHTML:
35
Box Breathing
After 1.5 ↑1.4 seconds of ADS without firing while Magazine is >0:
10% Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance and 40% increased Weakspot Damage for the next shot while ADS.
Heavy Sniper Rifles and Glaives receive 30% increased Weakspot Damage instead.
Timer starts as soon as the Aim Down Sights input is pressed.

Weakspot damage? Least convoluted way
Buffs "Precision Hits" against Shielded Combatants and works on weapons without Precision Multipliers as long as they hit the weakspot.
Weakspot Buffs do not work on a Divinity Bubble

policies.defaultSelection: No trait selected by default; master registers only these exact base rolls. Enhanced/exotic unsupported.
policies.ownership: Original count-one selected hotbar/equipped object, exact canonical entry and selected tuple; ServerPlayer/level/GuardianData/runtime/class/loadout/Super checked; accepted writers only; no query mutation. Old-owner cleanup cannot remove successor.
policies.integration: Master owns shared registry/runtime/aiming/handling/HUD and central tests. Token.NONE for perkSplash; never fresh capture at explosion.
policies.conversion: 20TPS elapsed server ticks are a provisional Minecraft mapping, not a measured Destiny clock.
policies.aa: Sourced Aim Assist metadata is exposed only. This server port has no AA or client magnetism implementation.
policies.validation: Focused event/timer/epoch cycle tests and isolated Java25 compile only; no numeric mirror tests, numeric-only Vision/fullgate, native or server QA.
policies.paid: update(p,actualAds) only after master validated FOV/handling ownership. capture(p,entry,roundsBefore,actualAds) after actual payment before trace; do not update using post-payment empty magazine first. Supplementals and perkSplash use Token.NONE.
policies.application: precisionMultiplier applies only to weakspot/precision hits; no body damage, generic damage or Dragonfly inheritance.
policies.snapshot: 30 elapsed ticks from actual ADS input with positive magazine, no firing. Paid shot consumes readiness; release/stow/reload/edit resets. False/true same tick restarts clock. Natural magazine-empty polling does not erase accepted last-round snapshot.
policies.uncertainty: DDC row35 text contains "Weakspot damage? Least convoluted way"; preserve raw question text as uncertainty. Shielded weakspot and Divinity semantics are not claimed simulated. Confirmed 40% for the two supported Special snipers; 30% Heavy/Glaive branch unsupported.
